Tips.English: The public is advised to pay attention to the following points: 1. Due to the large fluctuation in temperature, it is advisable to prepare additional clothing to avoid catching a cold. 2. Individuals with weaker constitutions (especially the elderly, young children, pregnant women, and those with chronic illnesses) should take precautions to stay warm when going outside. 3. Sudden drops in temperature can easily lead to physical discomfort (such as respiratory issues, joint pain, heart problems and gastrointestinal issues). Wearing a mask if necessary. Drinking plenty of warm water, and keeping different parts of the body warm are recommended. 4. It is often accompanied by strong winds when temperature drops. People with respiratory diseases or weak constitutions should be cautious of dust raised by the wind and pay attention to changes in air quality levels, adjusting their travel plans accordingly. 5. It is often associated with rainfall when temperature drops. When strong winds combine with cloudy and rainy conditions, the perceived temperature may feel lower than the actual temperature, so it is important to stay updated on the latest weather information.
